To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the university is a social organization, which is a social institution that is engaged in knowledge production; because of differences in organizational goal and value orientation of the university, the contemporary universities have formed three different types of organization: researching, researching-teaching and sole teaching.
the differences in organizational goals, value orientation and management mode of contemporary universities are the results of different organizational types.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following three aspects: the hierarchy of modern university, the differences of university types and the choices in management mode.
the hierarchy of modern university and its management mode, which is a significant issue in the reform of university system in China.
the following questions: (1) What are the differences in organizational goal, value orientation, management mode and operation mechanisms among the three different types of university?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the three types of universities should be managed respectively in accordance with the three different modes: the research university, the teaching-researching university and the sole teaching university.

the researching university, which is the highest level of modern universities, is the most scientific in its operation mechanism and management mode, while the sole teaching university is the least scientific.
a university should have its own management mode and operation mechanisms in accordance with the university’s own characteristics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the differences among the three types of university are not only in the organizational goals and value orientations, but also in the management mode, organizational structure and operation mechanism, which are the three basic aspects of university management.
a modern university is a social system which has a complex structure and a multi-layered hierarchy.

the differences in organizational goals, value orientation and management mode of universities are not only the inevitable results of the differences in the social functions of universities, but also the inevitable results of their different development stages.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the differences in the organizational goals and value orientations among universities lead to the differences in management modes.
the differences in organizational goals, value orientation and operation mechanism of universities are significant to the choice of management mode and the scientific orientation of universities.
the different types of universities should choose different management modes and operating mechanisms to meet the needs of the development of the university.
